title: Floating Figure in Cosmic Scene
description: A woman with closed eyes floats upside down in the center of the image, wearing a shiny green and gold patterned bodysuit and a black head covering with a white flower design. Her arms are outstretched with hands open, not touching anything, above a glowing circular pool on broken rocky ground that has waterfalls flowing down into darkness, with twisted bare trees on both sides and colorful aurora lights filling the space.
